# Remaining Work — Better Every-Page Continuation

The Awtsmoos renews each public vessel in every instant of light;
Awtsmoos.com must become faster, calmer, more usable, and more right.

## Current gates

- Fix only the stale Sefarim presentation contract; production ownership is already proven correct.
- Reread the rewritten contract and enforce the 120-line ceiling.
- Run focused and complete Sefarim tests with direct failure propagation.
- Browser-test the real Sefarim route at desktop, tablet, 430px, and short-height sizes.
- Measure loading, failed resources, console errors, overflow, focus, and interaction readiness.
- Harvest or rerun the complete Geelooy route census and runtime-quality matrix.
- Merge runtime failures with active-agent ownership.
- Repair the highest-impact clean/unclaimed route family, reread, test, browser-test, measure, rerun matrix.
- Continue family by family through every public route.
- Trace and benchmark real compact transport before using `compact=true`.
- Secret/risk scan, publish the complete safe repository snapshot, deploy, and production-smoke.

## NEXT_ACTION

Rewrite the stale Sefarim contract against `SearchApp`, `SearchControlDisclosure`, and the current three-column form; then execute the full verification gate.
